dedupe_keys.name: zones concernees par le raccordement aux reseaux de chaleur urbains

description: Zones concernées par le raccordement aux réseaux de chaleur urbains is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche localise les zones qui se situent à proximité des réseaux de chaleur urbains existants et futurs. Les périmètres sont de 50, 100 et 150m autour du tracé des réseaux. Ces périmètres sont destinés à identifier les permis de construire et projets d'aménagement pouvant faire l'objet d'un raccordement aux réseaux de chaleur urbains. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energie. Its keywords are réseau de chauffage urbain. The portal shows 130 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-10-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
